headline: First reading of Policy JICK on student safety and bullying prevention, plus FY26 fund balance and 2026-2027 school goals.
summary: The agenda includes a first reading of a bullying prevention policy and a review of the FY26 fund balance. It also lists the 2026-2027 school goals, administrator and committee updates, and a possible nonpublic session.
items: Public comment from Derry residents, parents of enrolled students, and district employees, up to 3 minutes per person
Policy JICK, Student Safety and Violence Prevention - Bullying, first reading
Future meetings: September 8, 2026 regular meeting; September 22, 2026 joint workshop with Town Council; September 22, 2026 regular meeting
Possible nonpublic session under RSA 91-A:3, II (a)
location: Derry Municipal Center, 3rd Floor Meeting Room, 14 Manning Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038
